verdict.rationale: Justworks is a SaaS payroll, HR and PEO platform, so operating it with natural-language commands is a fair axis to judge. The evidence pack only documents click-through UI navigation (Pay > Make a Payment, Time Off > Policies) and an Xero integration. It contains nothing on a natural-language interface, AI assistant or chat command layer, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
